context: What are the best things to do in Rochester, New York? Can you write them as a song and use music notation in your response? Make sure to include the keywords 'festival' and 'river'.

trace.content:
(Verse 1)
G - G7 - C - C7
In Rochester, New York, there's so much to see
G - G7 - C - C7
From the Genesee River to the city's history
Em - D - G - G7
Visit the George Eastman Museum, a treasure to behold
Em - D - G - G7
Learn about the man who invented the camera, stories untold

(Chorus)
C - C7 - G - G7
Rochester, Rochester, a city by the river
C - C7 - G - G7
With festivals and fun, there's always something to deliver
Em - D - G - G7
From the Lilac Festival to the Xerox Rochester Jazz Festival too
Em - D - G - G7
Rochester's got it all, come and see it through

G - G7 - C - C7
